entries.title: Share a campaign yourself, by link or on your site
entries.summary: Share campaigns can now go out without emails: pick **I'll share a link or embed**, launch, and use the **Share it yourself** card for the link, a QR code and an embed for your site. Sponsor and exhibitor cards read "Proud sponsor of" and "We're exhibiting at", and a launched campaign can be deleted.
entries.use_case: A team that already emails its speakers, or wants attendees to share from the confirmation page, gets every kit and tracked link without Sessionboard sending a single invite.
